title: Handover Requirements Matrix for Delivery & Pickup Appointments
content:
Field operations sets the handover requirements for Delivery & Pickup Appointments separately for each fulfillment method. The matrix shows which requirements each method applies at the handover and what each method permits.

| Fulfillment method | Government photo ID matching the buyer checked | Every buyer named on the purchase agreement present | Contactless handover allowed | Longest test drive before acceptance | Trade-in vehicle collected at the same appointment | Signed condition report with odometer | Pickup token or hub check-in code valid after the window start |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Hub Pickup | Required | Required | No | 5 miles | Yes | Required | 4 hours |
| Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup | Required | Required | Yes | 0 miles (no test drive) | Yes | Required | 2 hours |
| Kestrel Fly & Drive | Required | Required | No | 5 miles | No | Required | 8 hours |
| Kestrel Local Home Delivery | Required | Required | Yes | 5 miles | Yes | Required | 0 hours |
| Kestrel Extended-Zone Delivery | Required | Required | No | 5 miles | Yes | Required | 0 hours |
| Kestrel Enclosed White-Glove Delivery | Required | Required | No | 10 miles | No | Required | 0 hours |

### What each column means

- **Government photo ID**: whether a government photo ID that matches the buyer is checked at the handover.
- **Every buyer present**: whether every buyer named on the purchase agreement must be present at the handover.
- **Contactless handover**: whether the handover may be completed without contact with staff.
- **Longest test drive**: the greatest distance the buyer may drive the vehicle at the handover before accepting it. A figure of 0 means the method offers no test drive.
- **Trade-in collection**: whether a trade-in vehicle may be collected at the same appointment.
- **Condition report**: whether a signed condition report, including the odometer reading, is completed at the handover.
- **Pickup token or check-in code**: the number of hours a pickup token or hub check-in code stays valid after the start of the window.

### Reading the matrix

- All six methods check photo ID, require every named buyer to be present and complete a signed condition report with odometer.
- Contactless handover is allowed only under Kestrel Vending Tower Pickup and Kestrel Local Home Delivery.
- Vending Tower Pickup offers no test drive. Enclosed White-Glove Delivery allows the longest, 10 miles. Every other method allows 5 miles.
- A trade-in cannot be collected at a Fly & Drive or Enclosed White-Glove appointment. Every other method allows it.
